rows.grounds: accusative object attribute in the bowing phrase

items.question: What form of the field-protector does the practitioner bow to in this Kaula rite?
items.inference: The verse directs bowing to a sky-blue field-protector bearing a skull-staff and a ḍamaru.
uncertainties: kṣetrapālaṃ is treated as masculine accusative
ritual setting beyond the verse is not specified
items.plain_english: I bow to the field-protector, sky-blue, bearing a skull-staff and a ḍamaru.
